verdict.rationale: Folk ships its own REST API and an official MCP server. Deals can be read via the custom-object endpoints, and the MCP use cases include querying relationships in plain language. Gmail conversations sync into folk, but nothing shows agents can retrieve emails or interaction history through the API or MCP, and there is no documented pre-meeting brief workflow. missing for 10: API/MCP access to synced emails and activity history, a documented account-brief or meeting-prep use case, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Deals are read and written with the custom object endpoints, with `Deals` as the `objectType` path parameter.
Find relationships in plain language with folk MCP
